entities.name: MsrP (query sequence)
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (100% identity and coverage; E-value 3.04e-254) to reviewed Salmonella MsrP references B5F7N7 and Q57J91.
MsrP is the catalytic subunit of the MsrPQ system; reduces protein methionine sulfoxide (both R and S forms), repairing oxidized periplasmic proteins using respiratory-chain electrons.
Annotated biological process: protein repair; protects periplasmic proteins and envelope integrity from oxidative stress.
Annotated localization: periplasm; associates with the inner membrane when interacting with MsrQ.
Sequence length 334 aa; estimated molecular mass 37,477 Da.

entities.name: MsrQ
observations: Partner subunit of the MsrPQ system; MsrP associates with the inner membrane when interacting with MsrQ.
